trello.name: Implement queue depth alerts for worker fleets
trello.desc: Kofi will create alerts for queue depth on all worker fleets with thresholds set to warning at 1,000 jobs and page at 5,000 jobs to detect issues early.

trello.name: Fix payment worker retry logic
trello.desc: Marta will update the retry logic in payment_worker.py with exponential backoff including jitter, cap retries, and send failed jobs to a dead-letter queue at the back instead of the front; she will also add tests simulating processor 503 errors.

trello.name: Increase and split database connection pools
trello.desc: Kofi will increase the database connection pool size from 20 to 100 and separate connection pools for workers and API in the same config file to prevent pool exhaustion during incidents.

trello.name: Update payment incident runbook
trello.desc: Priya will update the payment incident runbook to replace old Kibana links with new logging links, document the queue drain procedure, and verify that escalation phone numbers are current; Kofi will confirm her ownership.

trello.name: Automate status page updates for checkout errors
trello.desc: Marta will automate status page updates by linking it to the checkout error alert so when it fires, the status page automatically changes to investigating with a template message.

trello.name: Plan and review payment processor failover game day
trello.desc: Kofi will lead drafting a controlled chaos test plan for payment processor failover in staging and production during low traffic with a rollback plan; the plan will be reviewed in two weeks before execution.

trello.name: Schedule Redis upgrade to version 7.2
trello.desc: Kofi will schedule an upgrade for Redis from version 6.0 to 7.2 with proper planning on the infrastructure calendar, ensuring it is not a casual Friday deploy due to config changes and persistence default updates.
